dialogue: Find me coffee tables with coated steel, tempered glass, steel frame, and price lower than 160.00 dollars
I'd prefer matte black or bronze, not the shiny glam finishes.
I'd prefer something simple or industrial, not mirrored or glam.
Tempered glass is still preferred, but a wood-look or MDF top is okay if the table otherwise fits.
A lift-top with hidden storage would be better if it still has the black steel industrial look under $160.
I'd prefer a larger one, around 45 inches wide or more, not the compact 39-inch models if possible.

constraints.value: lift-top coffee table with hidden storage

agent_final_statement: Best available fit at $88.99: the selected 47.5-inch model has a matte-black powder-coated metal frame, MDF top, lift-top, and hidden storage. It uses the permitted MDF fallback rather than preferred tempered glass; the page describes the frame as metal rather than explicitly steel.

agent_product.title: Yaheetech 47.5 Inch Lift Top Coffee Table with Hidden Storage Compartment and Sturdy Metal Frame for Living Room, Farmhouse Lift up Center Table with Split Top, Large Capacity & Easy Lifting, Gray
agent_product.product_category: Home & Kitchen › Furniture › Living Room Furniture › Tables › Coffee Tables
bullet_points: 【Smart living room organizer】The split tabletop design pairs a gas lift top revealing two out-of-sight storage compartments. You can keep your daily items at hand by hiding them under the top, and have a neat tabletop to boot.

【Multi-tasking lift-top design】The coffee table sports a functional split tabletop – a gas-lift top on one side and a fixed surface on the other. The lift-top design can bring the tabletop to you when you’re relaxing on the couch, while the fixed surface can still hold cups, dishes, and laptops.

【Sturdy & Safe】Founded atop a clean-lined frame in a matte black finish, this sturdy lift-top coffee table boasts a powder-coated metal frame, CARB P2 MDF table with a water-resistant veneered surface, and a strong metal gas-lifting mechanism.

【Easy setup and maintenance】Necessary parts, accessory kit and illustrated assembly instructions are provided to help you set up the coffee table quickly and effortlessly. The water-resistant surface makes cleaning a breeze.

【Adjustable protectors】The lift-top coffee table features 4 protective feet to prevent accidental scratches or scuffs during use. In case of uneven floors, these screw-in feet help level the table to the floor.
